description: Open the therapist comparison spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/therapist_comparison.xlsx. The spreadsheet has 5 potential therapists with partial information. Fill in the missing Session Cost data using the reference notes in /home/ga/Documents/reference_notes.txt. Create a 'Monthly Cost' column with formula =Session_Cost*4. Create a 'Priority Score' column using the scoring criteria from notes. Add summary calculations for average in-network and out-of-network costs. Add a 'Status' column (Top Choice, Backup, Waiting, Ruled Out). Sort by Priority Score. Save (Ctrl+S).
